prompt: In the Delta data pipeline project, what happened between the milestone "Archive schema freeze" (/projects/delta/archive-schema-freeze.md) and the milestone "Quick-look viewer" (/projects/delta/quicklook-viewer.md)? The project's sequence is given by the `after:` frontmatter field (each milestone names the one immediately before it). List only the milestones strictly between those two, in sequence order, each with its title and path — not the two endpoints' neighbours on the other side. Change nothing. End your reply with a fenced code block tagged `answer` that lists ONLY the matching note paths, one per line (repository-root form, e.g. `/projects/x/y.md`), in the order asked; put explanations before the block, never inside it.

args.query: docs { select _path, title, $depth where _path == "/projects/delta/archive-schema-freeze.md" follow ^docs { after == ^_path frontier _path == "/projects/delta/quicklook-viewer.md" } order by $ordinal }

solution.final_text:
Between Archive schema freeze and Quick-look viewer, Delta went through three milestones, in order: Storage procurement (/projects/delta/storage-procurement.md), Pipeline v1 (/projects/delta/pipeline-v1.md) and Calibration database (/projects/delta/calibration-database.md).

```answer
/projects/delta/storage-procurement.md
/projects/delta/pipeline-v1.md
/projects/delta/calibration-database.md
```
